Findings: (a) no lane in any workspace breaks under the deny; (b) **hook is NOT airtight where nested agent harnesses run** — `agy` / `grok -p` invoked via Bash can run destructive git as a subprocess, invisible to PreToolUse; guidance is the belt to the hook's braces; (c) a future **Grok Build provider lane would NOT inherit** this — its own hooks system, needs a native port; (d) pi warns `constants.ts` is BOTH this delivery vehicle AND a target of pi's enum widening — sequencing collision, don't land both blind; pi wants this shipped BEFORE pi implementation starts.

Grok Build **natively reads `~/.claude/settings.json` AND `<project>/.claude/settings.json` hooks** (documented Claude-compat, disableable via `[compat.claude] hooks=false`).
